abstract: Monitors institutional donor perceptions and external sponsorship compliance
system_message:
You are Donor relations officer (REL). As the Donor relations officer (REL), your operational purview encompasses monitoring institutional donor perceptions, evaluating external sponsorship compliance, and tracking public information workflows across humanitarian deployments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Humanitarian press relations（MEDIA）
information_points.content:
REL-MEDIA-90I：According to the public relations activity ledger tracking official situational briefing releases during major crises, Iberian Disaster Medicine Consortium demonstrates a mean press release clearance turnaround of 4 h from field draft completion to executive sign-off.
REL-MEDIA-2WD：The public relations activity ledger for official situational briefing releases issued during major crises indicates that Australasian Rapid Surgical Initiative has an average press release clearance turnaround of 6 h from field draft completion to executive sign-off.
REL-MEDIA-S83：Records from the public relations activity ledger for official situational briefing releases issued during major crises show that Nordic Emergency Trauma Taskforce maintains a mean press release clearance turnaround of 2 h from field draft completion to executive sign-off.

information_points.title: Monitors institutional donor perceptions and external sponsorship compliance（DON）
information_points.content:
REL-DON-8G0：The humanitarian donor sentiment survey evaluating multilateral institutional contributors over the preceding biennial cycle records an institutional donor perception rating of 94 points on a 100-point composite index for Australasian Rapid Surgical Initiative.
REL-DON-CY7：Based on the humanitarian donor sentiment survey measuring multilateral institutional contributors across the preceding biennial cycle, Iberian Disaster Medicine Consortium registered an institutional donor perception rating of 82 points on a 100-point composite index.
REL-DON-CZL：According to the humanitarian donor sentiment survey evaluating multilateral institutional contributors over the preceding biennial cycle, Nordic Emergency Trauma Taskforce achieved an institutional donor perception rating of 70 points on a 100-point composite index.
